name: Disneyland Rancho del Zocalo Cinnamon Crisps (Crispy Flour Tortilla Buñuelos with Cinnamon Sugar)
brandOrRestaurant: Rancho del Zocalo Restaurante (Frontierland · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Made from refined white flour tortillas (not corn!) puffed crisp and dusted with cinnamon sugar—lighter and thinner than a thick churro and naturally dairy-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share an order of Cinnamon Crisps with the table (use caramel/chocolate dip sparingly).
watchOuts: Fried flour tortilla chips—share a portion in remission
